# CG-AUTH-001: Authentication requirement tightened

Some baseline credential no longer works, or anonymous access was removed.

**Why it matters:** Requests authenticated the old way become unauthorized.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Security](./#auth) |
| Detects | `security.alternativesChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: critical · potentially breaking: high · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Authentication of {operation} is stricter: {what}.
>
> Consumers using the affected credentials (or none) will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep accepting the previous credentials during a transition.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: security added to an open operation

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
-     get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
+     get: {security: [{bearer: []}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Authentication of GET /x is stricter: anonymous access is no longer allowed.

### Fires: one alternative removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
-     get: {security: [{key: []}, {oauth: [read]}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
+     get: {security: [{oauth: [read]}], responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
      oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: r, write: w}}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Authentication of GET /x is stricter: 1 previously accepted credential option(s) no longer work.

### Fires: root security added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
+ security: [{key: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
```

**Result:** Breaking, critical. Authentication of GET /x is stricter: anonymous access is no longer allowed.

### Does not fire: scheme renamed, identical definition

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- security: [{key: []}]
+ security: [{apiKey: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
+     apiKey: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: alternative added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
- security: [{key: []}]
+ security: [{key: []}, {bearer: []}]
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      key: {type: apiKey, name: X-Key, in: header}
      bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Credentials consumers actually hold are unknown.

## Silence or tune it

```yaml
rules:
  ignore:
    - rule: CG-AUTH-001
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:
    CG-AUTH-001: { severity: low }
```
